description: This Java class 'DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig' provides configuration settings for persistence streams, including max bulk size, parallelism, and exponential backoff configuration. It implements the PersistenceStreamConfig interface and is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.common.config' package.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing PersistenceStreamConfig, providing configuration for persistence streams including max bulk size, parallelism, and backoff settings.
